plan.notes: Source: Western New England University Academic Catalog 2025-26, program page CS.BS - BS in Computer Science (College of Arts & Sciences, Dept. of Computer Science & Info Tech), 'Computer Science Suggested Sequence of Courses' (pp. 210-212 of catalog; 'Total Credit Hours: 120'). Transcribed manually 2026-09-30 from the catalog's official PDF export. catalog1.wne.edu is WNE's Coursedog-hosted catalog; its homepage would not load from the collection sandbox on 2026-09-30 and the CS program page is not search-indexed, so the catalog's official Coursedog PDF export (the same official catalog content) was used as the source and is cited as source_url. True degree name per catalog: 'BS in Computer Science'. Sequence term subtotals (14/16/16/15/15/16/15/13) sum to 120, matching the catalog's stated degree total - no discrepancy. MATH 245 Topics in Linear Algebra and Calculus is the catalog's suggested-sequence pick for the required-mathematics 'one of' requirement (MATH 120/121/123/127/133/245/306/379); students may substitute another listed math course. GBD XXX = Golden Bear Discovery general-education courses (the 2025-26 launch of WNE's new gen-ed curriculum); student chooses. GEN XXX = general electives; student chooses. WIC 2XX / WIC 3XX/4XX = Writing Intensive Courses; specific courses student-chosen. CS/IT 3XX/4XX = the catalog's 6-credit Technical Elective: two additional CS courses numbered 300 or above, or CPE 311+, or IT 320/330/350/430/435/450, or CYBR 300/310/330/410/425/435 (only one of CS 300/310/CYBR 300/310 may count); catalog also notes CS/IT 111's prerequisite of ENGR 105 or instructor permission. Cross-listed pairs shown in the sequence as CS 101/IT 101, CS 102/IT 102, CS 200/IT 200 are modeled once under the CS code with the cross-listing documented in the slot note. CPE 271 title in the suggested sequence is 'Digital System Design' (catalog course listing titles it 'Digital Design'). Prereq chains are transcribed from each course's catalog 'Requisites' description: CS 200/210/220 require CS 102; MATH 251 requires MATH 150; CS 351 requires CS 200 + CS 210; CS 364 requires CS 102; CPE 310 requires CPE 271; CS 366 requires CS 200 + CS 210; CS 490 requires CS 210 + CS 220 (plus Senior Standing, satisfied by senior-fall placement); CS 413 requires CS 200; MATH 363 requires MATH 251 + CS 200; CS 492 requires CS 490; ENGL 133 requires C-or-better in ENGL 131/132/140-level or equivalent (modeled on in-plan ENGL 132); PH 225 requires Sophomore Standing (satisfied by junior-spring placement). No placement-test or assessment prerequisites beyond standard sequencing.
